messages:
ana: Quick sync: we're greenlighting ratecard experiment RC-APR-26. Need ops plan for invoice deltas and backfill for usage between rollout and next cycle. Thoughts? :signal_strength:

mike: for reserved customers we do soft-grandfather for active commits. question: do we show the new line item immediately on invoices for visibility, or wait until next billing cycle?

jess: showing new line item (informational) + not charging until next cycle is my fav. reduces surprise tickets. we'd need a one-line explanation and a support macro.

rebecca: vendor note 12: Marketplace partners require that we send SKU adjustments as a separate reconciliation file. We'll need a mapping table from old tiers to PS-APR-26. vendor-ops can automate ~85% but remainder manual.

nate: Billing system impact: two options:
1) Emit an invoice stub line labelled "Pending rate change" (no charge) and apply actual delta as a credit on next invoice.
2) Apply immediate prorated charge and create reversal if customer qualifies for grandfather.
My preference: option 1 fewer reversals.

mike: option 1 seems safer. Jess + Nate can you sketch ledger flow? include examples for monthly and annual prepay.

jess: will draft flow. example: customer A monthly, usage 1,200 token units in cycle. New rate increases unit price by $0.002 -> projected delta = 1,200 * 0.002 = $2.40. Show "Pending rate change: $2.40" on current invoice, apply credit of $2.40 on next invoice if no renewal during grandfather.

sandeep: eng ops considerations: we need to tag events with price-version header so analytics ties usage to cohorts. propose header X-RW-Price: "RC-APR-26" and emit a metric rw.pricing.version.count by cohort. Also adding an export to billing webhook so ledger can consume per-request granularity.

ana: small correction: header name should be X-Redwood-Price-Version for consistency with other experiments. sandeep pls update.

sandeep: updated. will also add a lightweight bulk export for vendor mappings.

rebecca: partnerships will provide SKU mapping CSV by Tue. i'll include a column for "manual_review" for the 15% edge cases.

jess: support FAQ snippets: 1) "Why am I seeing a pending rate change?" 2) "Will I be charged today?" 3) "How does the promo opt-in work?" I'll draft and post in #support-desk.

mike: analytics ask: can we get cohorted MRR projection for the first 60 days and churn delta estimate? Need numbers by Mon EOD.

sandeep: will emit the cohort metric and a daily export to datawarehouse. estimate 1.5 engineer days to finalize schema and dashboard hook.

nate: FYI on edge case: customers on annual prepay with auto-renew happening mid-cycle. We should not apply credits that push final invoice negative beyond allowed credits. We'll cap net credit to invoice amount and carryover remainder as balance. Ops ok?

jess: agreed. add note in ledger flow doc.

billing-bot: Reminder: next billing calendar lock is 2026-04-04 23:00 UTC. Any pricing files not submitted by lock will apply to following cycle.

ana: action list: 1) ledger + support flows (jess + nate) 12 Fri EOD. 2) vendor SKU map (rebecca) 12 Tue EOD. 3) eng header + metric + export (sandeep) 12 PR by Mon. 4) analytics cohort projections (mike) 12 Mon EOD. 5) legal/terms blurb if needed (ana will loop in legal).

mike: will post the dashboard template by Mon.

rebecca: vendor-ops ack'd timeline. they'll auto-map and flag manual ones.

ana: thanks all. if anything blocks the mapping or ledger flow, escalate early. prefer slight delay vs customer confusion. :thumbsup:
